text:
Alex: Quick sync — we need to lock launch pacing + burst policy for Dedicated capacity. Customer asks coming in; want to align on go/no-go criteria by EOD.
Priya: TL;DR of asks: Lighthouse wants a firm short-burst guarantee (30s p95 latency), legal wants explicit SLA language for preemption, sales asks for a low-friction opt-in pilot.
Sam L.: infra reality — hard 30s p95 for all request shapes is expensive. We can meet it for typical chat seqs with prewarm + micro-pools, but not for worst-case long-seq generative loads.
Jordan K.: proposal: staged rollout. Phase 1 = Pilot (2 customers) with opt-in dedicated micro-pools + telemetry. Phase 2 = GA with advertised burst envelope and backoff fallback.
Alex: sounds reasonable. We need concrete launch criteria for Phase 1 though. My draft: 1) pilot onboarding docs + support runbook, 2) <https://docs.redwood.com/dedicated/launch-checklist> automated tests green, 3) observed p95 latency <= 40s under pilot traffic for 2 weeks, and 4) cost delta within expected band. Thoughts?
Priya: add one more: documented rollback triggers (e.g., sustained error rate >1% or 3x latency regression vs baseline). Also include clear customer-facing caveat: "burst guarantees apply to typical request shapes; large seqs may be scoped or throttled."
Sam L.: can do. For autoscale policy we should use a 60s up-hold + 3min cooldown down-hold to avoid flapping. Proposed config snippet:
```
prewarm_policy: "micro-pool"
burst_window_seconds: 30
autoscale_up_hold: 60
autoscale_down_cooldown: 180
fallback: ["lower-precision-quantized", "regional-fallthrough"]
```
Jordan K.: pilot gating checklist: customer acceptance test (CAT) scripts, billing opt-in form, alerting to oncall w/ runbook, and a short SLA addendum for pilots. We should also capture prompt sets for quality regression tests.
Alex: who owns the SLA wording? Priya + Legal? We need the wording by tomorrow so sales can sign the first pilot LOI.
Priya: I'll draft the pilot SLA addendum and highlight preemption language. Legal review request in the queue — tagging @legal here (cc @sam_lee for technical details). :wave:
Sam L.: I'll provide expected worst-case cost numbers and prewarm sizing table by noon.
Jordan K.: ops-bot, please create a pilot oncall rotation alias and a temporary alert policy for dedicated-pilot channel.
ops-bot: Created alias #pilot-dedicated-oncall and alert policy 'dedicated-pilot-critical' (pager on, 5min). See runbook link: <https://runbooks.redwood.com/dedicated-pilot-runbook>.
Alex: OK — next steps: Priya draft SLA addendum, Sam send sizing + costs, Jordan prepare CAT scripts + billing opt-in, I'll compile launch criteria doc and circulate. If we hit those, we flip the pilot toggle next week. :thumbsup:
Priya: ack.
Sam L.: ack.
Jordan K.: ack.
Alex: thanks everyone — keep thread updates short, we'll do a 10m stand if anything blocks. :clock10:
